s.t:
Deine Rolle
Als Product Manager BESS & PCS (m/w/d) übernimmst du die End-to-End-Verantwortung für die Produktfamilie der Outdoor-Energiespeichersysteme von STABL sowie für unsere proprietäre Leistungselektronik. Deine Mission ist es, wettbewerbsfähige, hochwertige Produkte zu gestalten, die echte Kundenbedürfnisse lösen und das Wachstum von STABL unterstützen.

Du wandelst Erkenntnisse aus Markt, Kunden und Stakeholdern in eine klare Produktausrichtung um und arbeitest funktionsübergreifend daran, das Portfolio kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Als Teil des Business Innovation Teams stellst du sicher, dass Marktfeedback klar in unsere Organisation eingebracht und anschließend umgesetzt wird.
Deine Mission
Du verwaltest nicht nur eine Roadmap – du gestaltest aktiv die nächste Generation von Energiespeichersystemen in einem hochdynamischen Umfeld. Diese Position ist ideal für jemanden, der groß denkt, gerne Hardware und Software miteinander verbindet und Produkte entwickeln möchte, die Kunden begeistern – für ein skalierendes und sich gleichzeitig kontinuierlich weiterentwickelndes Produkt in einer der am schnellsten wachsenden Branchen der Energiewende.
Du sammelst Kunden- und Marktanforderungen und übersetzt diese in klare Produktanforderungen und Prioritäten.
Du stellst die technische Exzellenz, die kommerzielle Wettbewerbsfähigkeit und die Gesamtqualität der Lösungen sicher.
Du agierst als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, dem Markt sowie internen und externen Stakeholdern.
Du führst Wettbewerbsanalysen und Marktforschung durch, um Trends, Chancen und Risiken zu identifizieren. Dabei arbeitest du an Systemen, die an gewerblichen und industriellen Standorten eingesetzt werden, und sorgst für die richtige Balance zwischen Leistung, Kosten und Sicherheit in einem sich schnell weiterentwickelnden regulatorischen Umfeld.
Du bereitest strategische Entscheidungsgrundlagen vor und präsentierst diese. Außerdem steuerst du Produkte und zugehörige Initiativen über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus – von der Konzeption und Validierung bis hin zur Markteinführung und kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung.
Dein Profil
Mehr als 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement oder Product Ownership, idealerweise im Cleantech-, EPC-, Industrie-, Elektronikbereich oder einem vergleichbaren B2B-Umfeld sowie mehr als 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Energiespeicherung, idealerweise mit BESS.
Ausgeprägte Fähigkeit, Kunden-, Markt- und Geschäftsanforderungen in klare Produktanforderungen, Prioritäten und Roadmap-Entscheidungen zu übersetzen.
Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Management von Produkt-Roadmaps sowie in der bereichsübergreifenden Abstimmung mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern und Fachbereichen.
Starkes analytisches und strategisches Denkvermögen sowie Erfahrung in den Bereichen Marktforschung, Wettbewerbsanalyse und Produktpositionierung.
Hervorragende Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, vertrauensvoll mit Kunden, Partnern und internen Teams zusammenzuarbeiten. Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.
Strukturierte, proaktive und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise; Erfahrung mit B2B-Kunden aus dem Energie- oder Infrastrukturbereich ist von Vorteil.
Warum STABL Energy?
STABL Energy gehört zu den innovativsten Start-ups der Energiewende, ist Gewinner des ees Award 2022 , des pv magazine Award 2025 und wurde als eines der Top 100 Energy Start-ups weltweit ausgezeichnet. Wir werden von renommierten und erfahrenen Tech-VCs aus Deutschland, Dänemark und der Schweiz unterstützt.
Darauf kannst du dich freuen
Agile, offene und innovationsgetriebene Unternehmenskultur mit flachen Hierarchien, schnellen Entscheidungswegen und echter Eigenverantwortung.
Betriebliche Altersvorsorge zur Unterstützung deiner Zukunftsplanung.
Flexible Arbeitszeiten, ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell sowie die Möglichkeit, zeitweise aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten.
Digitale Essensgutscheine mit Circula Lunch – genieße dein Mittagessen auf uns!
Monatlicher Sachbezug, den du bei deinen Lieblingsgeschäften einlösen kannst.

Regelmäßige Teambuilding-Aktivitäten und Team-Events.
EGYM Wellpass – trainiere ohne Limits in zahlreichen Fitnessstudios in ganz Deutschland.
Bereit, Innovation voranzutreiben, etwas zu bewegen und andere zu inspirieren? Bewirb dich jetzt!
Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören und gemeinsam mit dir das Energiesystem der Zukunft zu gestalten! Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst, möchten wir dich ausdrücklich ermutigen, dich zu bewerben. Unser Motto lautet „Hire for attitude, train for skills“ – deshalb schätzen wir Potenzial und lebenslanges Lernen genauso sehr wie Erfahrung.

At DICK’S Sporting Goods , we believe in how positively sports can change lives. On our team, everyone plays a critical role in creating confidence and excitement by personally equipping all athletes to achieve their dreams. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workforce, reflecting the communities we serve.

If you are ready to make a difference as part of the world’s greatest sports team, apply to join our team today! OVERVIEW: At DICK’S Sporting Goods, our Scorecard membership sits at the center of the Athlete experience—driving engagement, retention, and long-term value.

As we evolve toward a paid membership model , we are seeking a Principal Product Manager to define and lead a step-change in our Loyalty, Membership, and Credit strategy, roadmap, and execution model . This role goes beyond incremental optimization.

You will reimagine the future of Loyalty and Membership , shaping a differentiated value proposition, unlocking new revenue streams, and ensuring seamless integration across our digital ecosystem.

You will lead end-to-end product strategy and discovery for highly complex, enterprise-wide initiatives—working across product, engineering, data, marketing, and external partners to deliver a cohesive and high-impact roadmap. What You’ll Own 1. Step-Change Product Strategy & Roadmap Leadership
Define and drive a bold, future-oriented Loyalty & Membership strategy (including paid membership)
Move beyond incremental improvements to deliver step-change innovation in customer value and business impact
Build and continuously evolve a multi-horizon roadmap (Now / Next / Future) aligned to enterprise strategy
Clearly articulate tradeoffs, investment rationale, and long-term value to executive leadership
Ensure roadmap reflects enterprise dependencies and cross-product integration points

2. Product Discovery Leadership
Design and lead a scaled discovery strategy across multiple product teams and domains
Establish discovery as a continuous, measurable discipline —not a phase

Customer research & segmentation (especially membership behaviors)
Experimentation frameworks (A/B, pilots, pricing tests)
Concept validation for new membership benefits and monetization models

Translate insights into clear product opportunities, business cases, and roadmap decisions

Champion human-centered design and data-informed decision making across teams
Co-lead discovery efforts with Principal UX Design and business stakeholders , ensuring: Customer desirability, business viability, and technical feasibility are equally represented

Facilitate cross-functional discovery workshops that bring together: Product, Design, Engineering, Data, and Business teams

Drive alignment early by ensuring discovery outputs are co-owned and actionable across teams

3. Loyalty & Paid Membership Expertise
Own evolution of Scorecard into a modern loyalty + paid membership ecosystem

s.h: Membership tiers, benefits, and pricing strategy
s.t:
Engagement loops and lifecycle mechanics
Value exchange for Athletes and brand partners

s.h: Bring deep knowledge of loyalty constructs , including
s.t:
Earn/burn systems, rewards structures
Personalization and lifecycle marketing
Subscription/membership economics and retention levers

Evaluate and optimize ROI, LTV, and engagement metrics

4. Digital Ecosystem & Cross-Product Integration
Operate with a systems-thinking mindset —understanding how Loyalty & Membership connects across:
E-commerce & app
Retail store experience
Retail media network
Data & personalization platforms
Marketing technology stack

Partner across product teams to ensure roadmap alignment and coordinated execution

Identify and manage dependencies, integration points, and sequencing risks

Drive shared outcomes across product portfolios , not siloed success
Serve as the central orchestrator across multiple product teams , ensuring Loyalty & Membership capabilities are intentionally embedded across the ecosystem—not layered on top

s.h: Partner with peer Product leaders to
s.t:
Align roadmaps and sequencing across domains
Resolve competing priorities and shared dependencies
Drive shared OKRs and integrated outcomes , not siloed metrics

Ensure consistency in experience, data usage, and value delivery across all touchpoints (digital + store)
5. Enterprise Leadership & Influence
Lead without authority across a highly matrixed organization

Align executives and cross-functional leaders on strategy, priorities, and trade-offs

Executive reviews and roadmap alignment sessions
Cross-functional planning and prioritization forums

Act as a thought leader in product strategy , elevating the maturity of the organization
Act as the unifying leader across Product, Design, and Business , ensuring alignment from vision through execution
Influence not just product direction, but also business strategy and operating models related to Loyalty and Membership
Create clarity in complex, multi-team environments by connecting strategies across teams into a single, coherent narrative

6. Cross-Functional Partnership
Build deep partnerships with Business leaders (Marketing, Loyalty, Merchandising, Finance, Retail Media) to co-create strategy, not just align on it
Operate as a thought partner to the business , shaping both customer value propositions and commercial models (especially for paid membership)

s.h: Partner closely with a Principal UX Designer to jointly define
s.t:
End-to-end Athlete experience vision
Differentiated, design-led membership experiences
Scalable design systems that support loyalty and personalization

Establish a Product + Design + Business triad model to ensure decisions are:
Customer-centered
Commercially viable
Technically feasible

Execution & Delivery Oversight
Ensure teams deliver against a cohesive, integrated roadmap

Identify and mitigate risks across product, tech, and business dimensions

Riverlane’s mission is to master quantum error correction (QEC) and unlock a new age of human progress. From advances in material and climate science, to complex chemistry simulation for new drug design, quantum computers will help humanity solve some of its most important challenges.

But without QEC, the industry’s defining technical challenge, such breakthroughs can never be achieved. Riverlane is the world leader in QEC technology. QEC is a complex problem that requires a range of skills, talent and passion.
Having raised more than $125M in funding to date to accelerate our cutting-edge R&D in quantum error correction (QEC), Riverlane partners with many of the world’s leading quantum hardware providers and government agencies to make fault tolerant quantum computing a reality. We’re making remarkable progress and growing fast.

Deltakit is Riverlane’s open-source software development kit (SDK) for QEC which is designed to help researchers build, test and run QEC workflows as the field of quantum computing rapidly evolves.
You’ll sit right at the heart of Deltakit, working closely with users, partners and cross-functional teams to deeply understand real-world challenges and translate them into a compelling product direction. You’ll use a blend of user insight, product data and market context to cut through complexity and focus on what matters most.
You’ll own and evolve Deltakit’s strategy and roadmap, bringing together engineering, research, business development and marketing around a shared vision. You’ll strike the balance between bold, long-term ambition and what’s realistically achievable today, helping us build for the future of quantum computing while delivering value right now.
Beyond the roadmap, you’ll play a key role in bringing Deltakit to life for the community. From supporting launches to engaging directly with users, you’ll shape how we show up, tell our story, and communicate the product’s value in a way that excites and inspires people to build with it.

About A1M
A1M Solutions is a woman-owned small business driven by the aspiration to provide value to our customers, employees, partners, and community while remaining aligned to our guiding principles of foundational values, deliberate focus, and empathetic connection.
A1M’s mission is to preserve and improve government healthcare programs that are lifelines for underserved people in the United States, including people in poverty, elderly people, members of ethnic and racial minorities, immigrants, and refugees. We look for projects with nation-wide impact at the intersection of policy, data, and user experience design.
Besides building useful and usable digital services, A1M helps teams improve their agile, user-centered design practices – or helps them get started. Our goal is not just to build sustainable public services, but also to leave our teaming partners and customers more skilled and more confident in the future.
Technology Delivery at A1M
Product Managers report into the Product Practice at A1M. They help teams execute on a vision, and craft a project strategy. They work in cross-functional, cross-organizational teams, often with policy experts and specialists as well as coordinating with technical teams.
Product management in government involves weaving inputs from stakeholders, policy domain experts, users, and technical partners into a unified path forward. This is particularly true for the lifeline government healthcare programs that serve millions of people. Listening, communication, and prioritization skills are more important to success than technical or business innovation.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will work with minimal guidance to carry out product management work with cross-functional teams. You will define a compelling vision, generate a clear strategy to achieve it, then work with teams and partners to build out an agile roadmap for delivery. You are excited to build high functional teams and cooperative relationships.
It’s wonderful if you have a background in policy or healthcare, but you don’t need to have deep knowledge. What we do expect is that you enjoy building relationships across organizational boundaries and treat the contributions from other domains and functions as crucial for product success. Senior PMs do not have formal people management responsibilities, but skills in teaching and coaching are essential.

Own the enhancement request pipeline across multiple strategic enterprise accounts at once. Build and maintain a structured system to track, prioritize, and respond to customer-sourced requirements, and keep requests moving rather than leaving them in “under consideration.”

Turn input from strategic accounts into successful products. Look for patterns across accounts. Shape some of these patterns into formal partnerships for design. Make sure the resulting capabilities benefit the wider market, not just the single customer that made the request.
Feed validated customer patterns back into the core product roadmaps, influencing direction well beyond the accounts you cover.

Operate across Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Legal. Support deal cycles as a product resource through RFP responses, security questionnaires, and roadmap presentations to prospects.
Navigate tension between a customer's contractual expectations and the internal roadmap , and tackle it directly rather than through routine escalation.
Create artifacts such as roadmap trackers, enhancement request dashboards, and decision memos that give customers and internal stakeholders visibility without requiring a meeting.
Advocate for customer needs inside the company while resisting the pull of the loudest or largest customer setting the roadmap at the expense of the broader market.

Do you know what product management is really about? If you do, then you know it isn't roadmaps, tickets or beautifully groomed backlogs. It's finding a real, expensive, unglamorous problem that people live with every day - and shipping something that makes it go away. That is product.
At Shape Construction, we are building software that transforms how construction projects are delivered. It's born out of real project experience and designed to bring clarity, structure and performance to complex environments.
The problem we are solving is one of the oldest in the industry: what actually happens on a construction site never makes it, intact, to the people who need it. Supervisors, field engineers and site managers see reality first: work blocked, plans deviated from, instructions given verbally, conditions nobody planned for.

That knowledge lives in heads, notebooks, camera rolls and group chats. Meanwhile the people responsible for the commercial health of the project are working weeks behind, from whatever fragments they can piece together. By the time anyone needs to prove what happened, the evidence has gone cold.
We are building the platform that closes that gap. Tools the site genuinely wants to use, capturing what happens as it happens, and then turning that raw signal into structured, trustworthy records that let commercial and project leadership make decisions, hold their ground and protect margin they would otherwise have written off.
This is your opportunity to own a core part of that. You won't be handed a roadmap to administer, you'll shape it, defend it, and be measured on whether customers are genuinely better off. If you like being close to messy real-world problems, have strong opinions about what to build and the discipline to kill your own ideas when the evidence says so, keep reading.
(this will be a long write up but we like to give you all the details before you spend your time applying)

We are digitising the largest and most fundamental industry in the world, the industry that literally builds the foundations of the civilisation we all depend on to spare us from a brutal hunter-gatherer life: CONSTRUCTION

As a Product Manager you'll own a core area of the Shape platform end to end, from the customer problem through to the outcome it produces on a live project.
You'll be accountable for a measurable business outcome for our customers, not for a feature list. Our platform spans two very different worlds, and both matter. On one side, the site: supervisors, field engineers and site managers working in conditions where an app has about five seconds to prove it's worth opening.

On the other, the office: project directors, commercial directors and quantity surveyors who need to trust what they're looking at enough to make a call on it. Value only appears when those two sides connect, and that connection is what we build.
Depending on where you're strongest and what the business needs, you might own the field side, the commercial side, or the seam between them. In every case the standard is the same: real adoption by people who have no obligation to use us, and a concrete outcome for the project as a result.
You'll also be at the front of how AI shows up in our products. A meaningful part of our ambition depends on AI doing genuinely hard things well in a domain with very little tolerance for confident nonsense, the stakes for our users are commercial and often contractual. You'll be the person who decides where AI earns its place, and where it doesn't.
Team
You'll be part of our Product team, working shoulder to shoulder with engineering, design, and our consultancy delivery teams, who are on live projects every day and are the sharpest feedback loop any product team could ask for. You'll also work closely with growth and customer success to make sure what we build reaches the people who need it.

Own the outcome: You will own a product area end to end, the problem, the strategy, the roadmap and the results. You'll define what success looks like in customer and commercial terms, and you'll be honest about whether we hit it.
Get close to the problem, on both sides: You'll spend real time on live projects, in the site cabin and in the commercial meeting, with our consultancy teams, and in the data. You'll build a deeper understanding of how a construction project actually runs, and of the commercial machinery behind it, than most people in our industry have, and use it to make sharp calls about what to build and what to refuse.

You will design and scale model-driven infrastructure that continuously interprets transactional data, generates reference pricing, detects performance shifts, reconciles financial flows, and governs revenue integrity in real time.
This is a foundational role at the intersection of marketplace economics, machine learning, and financial systems. Build the supplier intelligence layer , transforming transactional data into automated performance signals, demand insights, and pricing diagnostics.
Establish and govern the canonical source of truth for revenue, margin, take rate, transactions, and cancellations across systems and partners.
Design model evaluation, monitoring, and feedback frameworks , including drift detection and continuous improvement mechanisms.
Drive cross-functional execution across Engineering, Data Science, Finance, Commercial, and Supply to deliver production-grade, model-integrated infrastructure.

5+ years of Product Management experience, including ownership of AI-native products and model-driven systems in production. You have built and scaled systems where AI is foundational to product behavior — not an additive feature.
Hands-on experience writing prompts, designing evaluation harnesses, or prototyping with LLMs/foundation models as part of their PM workflow (not just overseeing others doing it)
Strong fluency working independently with SQL and large-scale transactional datasets .
Demonstrated experience operating as an AI-native PM , with hands-on ownership of model lifecycle management including problem framing, signal design, evaluation metrics (e.g., precision/recall tradeoffs, forecasting accuracy), monitoring frameworks, drift detection, and retraining strategies.
Experience shipping predictive systems, anomaly detection platforms, automated decisioning infrastructure, or model-driven pricing systems at scale.
Experience owning pricing systems, financial reporting platforms or marketplace intelligence tools.
Deep understanding of marketplace economics, revenue mechanics, and pricing strategy.
Track record of delivering complex, cross-functional systems with measurable business impact.
Exceptional communicator able to operate effectively across technical and commercial stakeholders.

Prior experience in Data Science, Engineering, or a highly technical role.
Background in travel commerce, fintech, ads, or other transaction-heavy marketplace environments.

We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery.

No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve.

Hims & Hers is at an inflection point. We've built dozens of categories that people love, and we're great at the treatments themselves. But today those are dozens of separate, transactional relationships.

The opportunity in front of us is to invert that: to move from point solutions to one deepening relationship with each customer, where we understand them holistically across all of their concerns, help them navigate what to do, and let the individual treatments become secondary to the relationship itself.
That shift is what this role owns. It's a true 0-to-1 build, but not a cold start. You'll define a brand-new, relationship-first product experience that spans our existing categories and the new ones we create to support it, with everything we've already built as your foundation.

Picture a concierge-style experience for the person who knows they don't feel their best, wants to feel better, and is looking for a trusted guide rather than another one-off transaction: lab testing, continuous care, and access to treatment, wrapped into one experience that compounds over time.
This is a rare seat. We're a company known for physical product and transactional care, making the leap to a sticky, engagement-driven, relationship-driven digital experience. Few established companies reach that moment, and fewer put a single person at the center of it. You'll work across the entire company to define what it looks like, and you'll do it on top of the AI infrastructure we're building, as someone who works that way themselves.

Own the end-to-end consumer experience for this new relationship-first offering, from discovery and onboarding through ongoing engagement
Define the synthesis layer across our existing categories, and stand up the new product lines the offering needs
Partner with engineering and design to build AI into the core of the consumer experience
Partner with our clinical teams so protocols, safety, and education are core to the product experience
Shape short- and long-term roadmaps, driving long-term scalability while balancing day-to-day improvements
Operate with focus in a fast-growing, constantly evolving environment, where there are always more opportunities than resources

6+ years of product management experience, working collaboratively across cross-functional teams
A track record of building and shipping consumer products that customers love and that drive meaningful business impact
A strong, specific point of view on where AI can meaningfully reshape the consumer healthcare experience, and the excitement to build it into the core of the product
Fluency with AI agents and AI-native workflows. AI-native is your default operating mode: you work with agents the way most PMs work with docs, fluently and constantly
Strategic and tactical range: you can set the vision and also design and execute scalable processes from scratch, ideally in an operations-intensive environment
Strong communication and a low-ego, high-EQ style. You build alignment, partner well across functions, and bring people with you. This is a fully remote role, so clear written communication and proactive collaboration matter
Bonus: experience in health, wellness, or category-defining 0-to-1 products

s.h: Who is American College of Education
s.t:
Founded in 2005, American College of Education continues to be a leader in professional development through our online programs. The mission of ACE is to deliver high-quality, affordable, and accessible online programs grounded in evidence-based content, real-world experience and relevant application that places our students’ needs first.
ACE is a mission-driven institution continually recognized for its commitment to social responsibility and positive impact. As an Impact Institution, we believe we have a responsibility to our students, alumni, employees, communities, and society as a whole. Guided by our core values, we strive to create meaningful impact that extends well beyond our bottom line.
We prioritize candidate safety. Please note that all official communication will only come from our verified company email domain @Rippling.com

You are passionate about helping students achieve their educational goals. You thrive in a competitive and collaborative team environment. You are comfortable working remotely and have experience collaborating with others in a virtual environment. You possess a strong attention to detail.
The Product Manager, Student Acquisition owns the strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for the end-to-end student acquisition journey/value stream from prospective student through started student.

This role serves as the strategic bridge among Marketing, Enrollment, Admissions, Student Services, and IT, translating institutional growth goals and student needs into a prioritized, outcome-based product roadmap. The Product Manager aligns people, processes, data, and technology across the student acquisition technology ecosystem.

Success is measured through improved funnel conversion, faster decision-making and delivery, stronger operational efficiency, better prospective student experience, and clear accountability for the value delivered by technology investments.

ACE is committed to paying a competitive wage while staying true to our mission of maintaining high quality, affordable programs for our students. The starting salary range for this position is $145,000 plus all full-time employees are eligible for an annual bonus. Offers vary depending on education, prior experience, and expertise being applied to the role.
What We Look for in the Ideal Candidate
Demonstrates self-reliance by meeting/exceeding workflow needs.
Demonstrates positive attitude and motivation, concern for students, teamwork, and excellent time management skills.
Follows established processes as outlined by organization and leadership.
Completes assigned duties based on daily business needs and individual skill set.
Consistently produces a high volume of quality work.
Capable, adapts as needed, to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
Proven ability to work independently with limited supervision and with other department personnel.
Must support and embrace the College’s Impact mission to improve the people and communities we serve through our civic engagement initiatives.
Must have exceptional communication, organization, and time management skills.
Must be "self-motivated" as well as creative and efficient in proposing solutions to complex, time-critical problems.
Must be collaborative in driving decisions and a team-player.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.
Builds and maintains student satisfaction.
Recognizes and anticipates student needs.

In this role you will wear different hats, but your skills will be especially essential in the following areas:
Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and success measures for the Student Acquisition value stream, aligned with institutional enrollment, revenue, and student experience goals.
Own the end-to-end prospect-to-started-student journey; use research, journey mapping, funnel data, and stakeholder feedback to identify friction, unmet needs, and improvement opportunities.
Establish and monitor product objectives and key performance indicators, including speed-to-lead, stage conversion, application completion, yield, cycle time, adoption, data quality, and operational efficiency.
Prioritize initiatives across the product ecosystem based on expected business value, student impact, risk, cost, effort, dependencies, and strategic alignment; make transparent trade-off recommendations.
Translate business problems and desired outcomes into clear product requirements, acceptance criteria, and decision context for Product Owners, delivery teams, vendors, and implementation partners.
Partner with Product Owners and technology teams to sequence delivery, manage cross-platform dependencies, validate releases, and confirm that delivered capabilities achieve intended outcomes.
Guide product discovery, experimentation, usability testing, and continuous optimization; apply quantitative and qualitative evidence to product decisions.
Ensure consistent funnel definitions, lead qualification rules, attribution, consent, and data flow across channels and platforms in partnership with data and business owners.
Own the integrated product roadmap across CRM, marketing automation, digital experience, inquiry and application, communications, workflow, integration, analytics, and reporting capabilities.
Evaluate platform capabilities, vendors, and investment options; develop business cases and recommendations that address value, total cost, scalability, reliability, integration, and technical debt.
Align Marketing, Enrollment, Admissions, Student Services, IT, and executive stakeholders around priorities, decisions, risks, timelines, and measurable outcomes.
Partner with operational leaders on process design, service levels, adoption, training, change management, and readiness for peak enrollment cycles.
Ensure product decisions support FERPA, privacy, consent, accessibility, security, data governance, responsible AI, and other applicable institutional requirements.
Communicate roadmap progress, product performance, financial impact, risks, dependencies, and decisions to executive and operational audiences.

Bachelor's degree in business, technology, marketing, analytics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Five or more years of experience in product management, digital product strategy, business technology, CRM, enrollment technology, or a related discipline.
Demonstrated experience owning a product strategy and roadmap across multiple platforms, business functions, and stakeholder groups.
Experience using product discovery, customer research, journey mapping, experimentation, and data analysis to prioritize work and improve measurable outcomes.
Strong working knowledge of CRM and lead management, marketing automation, digital experience, workflow, integration, analytics, and reporting capabilities.
Proven ability to define meaningful product metrics, interpret funnel and operational data, build business cases, and evaluate value, cost, risk, and trade-offs.
Experience partnering with Product Owners and Agile delivery teams; ability to translate strategy and business problems into outcome-based requirements without prescribing technical solutions.

Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

What will you do Own the product requirements: gather needs from customers, the field, the market, and internal stakeholders (serviceability, modularity and product configuration, manufacturability, and cost targets), and turn them into clear, prioritized, solution-neutral requirements.
Establish our requirements engineering tooling and workflow: select and set up how we capture, trace, and maintain requirements, from customer need through specification to verification, including change control across releases. This is a foundational task in your first months.
Own and maintain the QDm.1 roadmap: propose what gets built and in what order, make the trade-offs explicit, and align decisions with the management team.
Work with the applications team on customer interactions and evaluations with fabs, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs, and translate what you learn into requirements.
For each requirement, define acceptance criteria from the customer's point of view so it is clear and testable when the need is met, and link them to customer evaluation and qualification plans.
Align with the Product Development department on scope and timing, and hand solution-neutral requirements into engineering: state the need and the why, and leave the how to the disciplines.
